rules: Founder, Vorta, Jem'Hadar and subordinate-state visuals are distinct components of a shared Dominion hierarchy.
Dominion styling may unify equipment/architecture/markings while species morphology remains separate.
Vorta or Jem'Hadar authority/rank is never inferred from species alone; exact uniform/equipment follows assignment state.
Subordinate member-state visuals must retain local identity rather than becoming generic Dominion clones.
forbidden_variation: Founder status inferred from generic Changeling form
